name: mpris-control
description: Control your music from MPRIS right here

mprisMusicControl.refreshInterval.description: How often to poll player and update timeline (in milliseconds).

enumDescriptions: Automatically match color of the current track album art.
Use a static custom color defined below.

mprisMusicControl.customBackgroundColor.description: Static background color for the card (used if background mode is set to 'custom'). Accepts HEX format.

mprisMusicControl.backgroundOpacity.description: Opacity level for the card background (from 0 to 1).

mprisMusicControl.artRadius.description: Album art corner radius in pixels (set to 50 for a clean circular view).

mprisMusicControl.artSpin.description: Enable continuous vinyl-like spinning rotation effect on album art during active playback.

mprisMusicControl.fallbackArtPath.description: Absolute system path to a custom image file (.png, .jpg, .svg) to use as an idle fallback placeholder. Leave empty for default extension asset.
